facts.text: Cedric signed a promissory note to pay the party 975 gold, three-quarters price for their treasure, once the caravans flow again and the goods can be trucked to town.
facts.uncertain_reason: Unclear whether the party still holds the note or pledged it to Malzazarik and Lady Hilda.

facts.text: The party owes Malzazarik and Lady Hilda payment from Cedric's promissory note for joining the party; the exact share was not stated, and nothing has been paid yet.
facts.uncertain_reason: The terms of the recruitment offer, including each recruit's share, were not specified.
